comments.author: Alf
comments.content:
Hi Alex.  Does the new interaction with html/java code give us a web browser interface without the Quest client?

That's the one thing that I've really hoped for in Quest!

Tell us more...

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content: Well we already have the ability to play games online - see www.textadventures.co.uk. I'll be extending this capability to Quest 5.0 games as well, and since we're already outputting to HTML this should be reasonably straightforward.

comments.author: Alf
comments.content: You're right.  But setting up the server was a bit roundabout.  Do-able, just not intuitive.  Thanks Alex!

comments.author: Mary
comments.content: The idea is brilliant! HTML is ideal for building a customized interface, and as far as I got an offline browser will be added to Quest. And what about CSS styles?

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content: Yes the interface in Quest 5.0 is an embedded Internet Explorer page, so the full power of CSS and JavaScript will be available to you.
